name: telomi-local-qwen-public-acoustic-v1
description: Paired VAD diagnostics over public real-world acoustic recordings. DEMAND living-room noise and Sony pantograph keyboard recordings are deterministically mixed with source-authored AISHELL-1 speech. The AMI case is directly recorded table-top microphone-array speech with official word annotations. These cases strengthen public acoustic coverage but never count as the two locally verified microphone identities or their missing physical-condition captures.
